description: Spec defines optional threading model (supportsThreads capability). Fields: threadRootId (String, optional), replyCount (server-set, count of replies), unreadReplyCount (server-set, unread replies for thread root). kith has replyTo but no thread aggregation. Requires server-side reply counting and unread tracking per thread root. Spec reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md lines 603-610, §Threads.
title: Implement Message threading (threadRootId, replyCount, unreadReplyCount)
